{"predictors": [
  {"name": "Online Presence", "construction": "Measure the number of visits to a company's website over a month.", "rationale": "Firms with a strong online presence may see increased customer engagement and thus higher future sales growth.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Patent Activity", "construction": "Count the number of patents filed by a company in the prior year.", "rationale": "Firms with higher patent activity may be more innovative, leading to new products and services.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Employee Satisfaction", "construction": "Survey data from a firm's employees rating their job satisfaction on a scale of 1-10.", "rationale": "Firms with high employee satisfaction may have lower turnover and higher productivity, leading to better performance.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Supply Chain Efficiency", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of completed orders to total orders over the past year.", "rationale": "Companies with efficient supply chains can minimize costs and deliver goods and services faster to the market.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Customer Retention", "construction": "Measure the percentage of customers retained from the prior year.", "rationale": "Companies with high customer retention may be more stable and have a loyal customer base.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Brand Strength", "construction": "Survey data measuring brand recognition and perception on a scale of 1-10.", "rationale": "Firms with strong brands may have a competitive advantage, leading to higher future sales.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Board Independence", "construction": "Calculate the percentage of independent directors on a firm's board.", "rationale": "A more independent board may lead to better governance and decision-making.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Product Diversity", "construction": "Count the number of distinct product or service categories a company has.", "rationale": "Companies with diverse product lines may be better able to adapt to changing market conditions.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Capital Expenditure Growth", "construction": "Calculate the year-over-year percentage change in a company's capital expenditures.", "rationale": "Firms investing heavily in their own growth may see higher future earnings.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
  {"name": "Executive Turnover", "construction": "Count the number of executive-level departures in the past year.", "rationale": "High executive turnover may indicate instability or internal issues within the firm.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}
]}
